Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ لَوْلَا الْوَاجِبُ مِنْ قَبُولِ أَمْرِكَ
Translation: My God, if it were not for the obligation to accept Your command
I would have deemed You too exalted for me to mention You

Arabic text: عَلَى أَنَّ ذِكْرِيْ لَكَ بِقَدْرِيْ لَا بِقَدْرِكَ
Translation: Since my remembrance of You is according to my capacity, not according to Your worthiness

Arabic text: وَمَا عَسَىٰ أَنْ يَبْلُغَ مِقْدَارِيْ حَتَّى أُجْعَلَ مَحَلًّا لِتَقْدِيسِكَ
Translation: And what is my stature that I should be a place for Your sanctification?

Arabic text: وَمِنْ أَعْظَمِ النِّعَمِ عَلَيْنَا جَرَيَانُ ذِكْرِكَ عَلَى أَلْسِنَتِنَا
Translation: And among the greatest blessings upon us is the flowing of Your remembrance on our tongues
And Your permission for us to supplicate to You, exalt You, and glorify You

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ فَأَلْهِمْنَا ذِكْرَكَ فِيْ الْخَلاءِ وَالْمَلَاءِ
Translation: My God, inspire us to remember You in private and in public
In the night and in the day
In public and in secret
In ease and in hardship
And comfort us with silent remembrance
And employ us in pure deeds
And pleasing efforts
And reward us with a full measure
My God, in You the infatuated hearts are bewildered
And upon Your recognition, diverse intellects are united
Hearts find no tranquility except in Your remembrance

Arabic text: وَلَا تَسْكُنُ النُّفُوسُ إِلَّا عِنْدَ رُؤْيَاكَ
Translation: And souls find no peace except in seeing You
You are glorified in every place
And worshipped in every time
And found in every moment
And called upon by every tongue
And magnified in every heart

Arabic text: وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ مِنْ كُلِّ لَذَّةٍ بِغَيْرِ ذِكْرِكَ
Translation: And I seek Your forgiveness for every pleasure without Your remembrance
And for every comfort without Your companionship
And for every happiness without Your nearness
And for every occupation without Your obedience
My God, You have said, and Your word is the truth:

Arabic text: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ آمَنُوْا اذْكُرُوْا اللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا
Translation: "O you who believe! Remember Allah with much remembrance
And glorify Him morning and evening"
And You said, and Your word is the truth:
"Remember Me, and I will remember you"
You have commanded us to remember You
And promised that You will remember us
As an honor, exaltation, and glorification for us
And here we are, remembering You as You have commanded us
So fulfill for us what You have promised us
O Rememberer of those who remember
And O Most Merciful of the merciful ones
